catalog.structure: 31-page letter PDF with a real text layer (Word to Distiller, 2002). PDF p1 cover and contents, p2 paint and oil, p3 general information (example table skipped), then diagram/table pairs: even page = diagram, odd page = table (pp5-21 SD decks, gear boxes and mulching kits; pp23-31 TCSS decks and gear boxes). validation.method: Born-digital PDF with a real text layer: parsed with pdftotext -layout, then every table page compared by eye with the 120-dpi page render and the part numbers cross-checked against an independent OCR pass; descriptions kept as printed except title headings (user decision).
validation.quantities: All printed quantities transcribed. UAR (2 rows) stored as printed with qtyNum null; one qty prints as the letter 'I' (mulching kit ref 6, C46701), stored as printed with qtyNum null.
validation.numericalIndex: Not applicable: the book has no numerical index. The cover index lists section titles and page numbers only, so there is no index cross-check and there are no index-vs-table differences.
